actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed more than 10 units in the last round, triggering the punish rule. With a wallet of 10.71 and punishment cost 0.3, the maximum severity affordable is 35, which I apply and also broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action. Look at last round contributions: Resident2 contributed 36.88 >10, Resident5 4.85, others 0. So a resident contributed >10: Resident2. Rule: If any resident contributed more than 10 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with max severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost)). Wallet=10.71, punishment_cost=0.3, floor(10.71/0.3)= floor(35.7)=35 severity. But must target that resident. So punish Resident2 amount=35. Ensure affordable: cost = severity * punishment_cost = 35*0.3 =10.5 which is <= wallet 10.71. So okay.

We can also broadcast warning but only one physical and one communication. We choose punish physical, and maybe also broadcast? Allowed both. Yes up to 2 actions. So include punish and broadcast warning.

Thus actions: punish Resident2 amount 35, broadcast message "Contribute less, or you'll be punished." Explanation.
